issues.detail: Covers mostly the happy path with no guidance on API errors (401/400/429), rate limits, failed webhooks, or backup/upgrade of the self-hosted instance.

scenarios.name: self-host-and-push-leads
scenarios.rationale: A pins the image to 2.3.3, sets BASEROW_PUBLIC_URL, sends a table-scoped token as 'Authorization: Token', POSTs to the single-row endpoint with user_field_names=true, and notes the token only works on the Leads table. B uses :latest, which the rubric forbids. B's Python script also posts to the /batch/ endpoint instead of the specified single-row endpoint, and it never says the token applies to one table only.

scenarios.name: rollup-total-paid-per-client
scenarios.rationale: B covers the link field with the reverse related field and gives a Rollup plus a filtered formula, with a Paid Amount helper-field alternative, but doesn't mention verifying new invoices. A gives the link, the reverse field and a filtered formula, and it does include a verification step, but it never uses the Rollup field type and its filtered formula is hedged, so it is less complete on the rollup and sum-restricted-to-Paid requirement.

scenarios.name: filter-update-rows-and-webhook
scenarios.rationale: A matches the rubric's list call (filter__Status__equal=Active, order_by=-Created), PATCH with a Token header, and Settings → Webhooks with the three row events, though it puts user_field_names=true only on the PATCH; B uses single_select_equal with an option ID instead of filter__Status__equal=Active, wrongly says webhooks need a JWT, and gives the API route rather than the Settings → Webhooks UI as its main path.
